notes: Costco.com is Akamai Bot Manager protected (confirmed again this session: curl_cffi 403 on chrome profiles, safari17_0 returns 200 but is the 'sec-if-cpt-container' behavioral-sensor interstitial; Playwright headless Chromium got net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR on every URL including the homepage, even with --disable-http2). Direct fetch (tier 1) and Playwright/CDP (tier 2) both exhausted per brief -> escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3, real logged-out Chrome browser) which reached every page cleanly (real Chrome fingerprint passes Akamai). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked again this session, same generic legacy-WCS disallows as before). Used the department landing page https://www.costco.com/pet-supplies.html ('Pet Supplies') as the Pet Care grouping node - its own 'Shop by Category' nav lists 10 real sub-category PLPs, each visited directly; qty taken from each page's own 'Showing 1-N of N' results header after full client-render (get_page_text after scroll-triggered lazy load). Two more genuine Pet Supplies PLPs (Dewormer/Flea & Tick Treatment, Pet Pharmacy & Medications) are linked from the same department page below the main category grid ('Shop by Pet Health/Prevention' banners) - included, both flagged per the open medical/veterinary policy gap. Pet Insurance (pet-insurance.html) is a services/marketing page, not a product PLP - excluded. 'Shop by Pet Type' (Dog/Cat/Other Pets) facet links on the department page are the SAME underlying Pet Supplies inventory refined by a Type_of_Pet attribute, not distinct categories/PLPs - not emitted as separate rows to avoid double-counting against the 10 category PLPs already captured. Pet Enclosures' left-rail Category facet exposed one internal sub-facet 'Chicken Coops & Accessories (6)' - this is a filter facet on the same houses-kennels-crates.html PLP (query-param refinement), not a distinct site-nav URL, so it was not split out as its own row (would double-count against the Pet Enclosures qty=20 total). Dog Food, Cat Food, and Pet Supplements are pet-food/consumable categories - flagged per the brief's open policy gap rather than silently dropped. Pet Toys & Treats (site URL is /pet-food-treats.html) mixes genuine Tier-1 toys with treats/chews (consumable) in one merged PLP that cannot be split by URL - flagged as a consumable-mix for manual review. Cat Trees (site URL is /cat-supplies.html, page title 'Cat Trees') is a real Tier-1 enrichment/furniture leaf, not a generic 'cat supplies' catch-all - verified via its Category facet and page content (cat trees/scratchers/condos only). No zero-result categories encountered; all 12 rows have qty > 0.
